gloss: sense of how much times have changed

definitions.gloss: the feeling that times have changed completely
definitions.explanation: The strong sense, looking back, that the world has changed so much that the past seems to belong to another age.

examples.japanese: {隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It feels like a different age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at old photos, I feel how much times have changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{学生時代|がくせいじだい}→学生時代：31805_gakuseijidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: When I think of my student days without mobile phones, I cannot help feeling how utterly times have changed.

notes:
A set phrase from written and formal speech: {隔世|かくせい} means 'a generation apart'. It almost always appears as {隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ or the bookish {隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧ (cannot help feeling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: things feel a world away
- {隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to be struck by how times have changed
- {隔世|かくせい}の{感|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧: cannot help feeling the times have changed

USAGE:
It describes the speaker's feeling about change between then and now, not a gap between people; for a generation gap, Japanese says ジェネレーション⟦ギャップ→ギャップ：31230_gyappu⟧ or ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧.
